title: With nem or a question word: be goes after the verb

sections.title: Statement or no?
sections.content: In a plain statement or a yes/no question the prefix stands in front of the verb: *Bemegyek. Bemész?* After *nem* or a question word the verb comes first and the prefix follows as a separate word: *Nem megyek be. Mikor mész be?* The same happens with *felszáll* (gets on) and *leszáll* (gets off), two verbs you will use at a stop: *Felszállok. Nem szállok fel.*
Do not write *nem bemegyek*. With *nem* the prefix leaves the verb: *Nem megyek be.* The same goes after *mikor* and other question words: *Mikor mész be?*
